newsitem.title: CHINA: More travellers use China's roads in 1996.
newsitem.headline: More travellers use China's roads in 1996.

text.p: More travellers used China's roads in 1996 while the number of train passengers declined, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The number of train passengers dropped by 12.3 percent last year, while highway passenger transport volume rose by 9.5 percent to 11.4 billion people. it said.

Roads remained the most important mode of transport in China, carrying 10 billion tonnes of goods last year, an increase of 6.4 percent. That was equivalent to 500 billion tonnes per kilometre, a rise of 6.5 percent.
Rail freight increased by just 1.4 percent last year, Xinhua said.
China completed the construction of 25,000 km of roads last year, bringing the total length of China's highways to to 1.18 million km. Of this, 17,800 km are high-grade roads.
